g.text: Tenant: the x-tenant-id header; every table but tenants carries tenant_id

text.tspan: deletion_receipts: the org named only by sha256(tenant, org id), no org_id;
no delete path touches them, so they outlive the org (pruned after 3 years)

g.text: Org: created by CreateOrg, never on first use; every table but tenants, orgs and deletion_receipts carries org_id

text.tspan: Every store call takes a BankRef (tenant, org, bank);
every index on bank rows starts (tenant_id, org_id, bank_id)
Ids: non-empty, at most 256 bytes, no '/', no control
characters, not . or ..: prefixes stay unique per org and bank
DeleteBank: the bank's rows and blob prefix
DeleteOrg: every bank, the org's rows in every table

g.text: Bank: created by the first write in its org; bank-scoped rows carry bank_id

text.tspan: the original text of each document content
